_comment: OPT-IN seeded forecast for a real-inventory pilot. Rename to forecast.json inside your MCP_CONFIG_DIR to activate. Values are a ONE-TIME GAM report export, NOT a live avail — the node still labels every forecast result synthetic:true (pre-loaded is not a live read). Absent → the deterministic synthetic source (v1 behavior). Each bucket entry sets EXACTLY ONE of `bucket` (low|mid|high) or `avail_impressions` (mapped through `thresholds`). An unseeded family/period falls through to the synthetic source, so a partial seed still answers every request.
